## Definition of done

- [ ] `npm run verify` passes
- [ ] API changes have e2e tests and `npm run verify:e2e` passes
- [ ] Business rule changes update `docs/domain.md` (BR id) and a `libs/domain` test
- [ ] Entity changes keep existing column names, or the data plan is described below
- [ ] New conventions come with an enforcer and an ADR in `docs/decisions/`
